description: This Java source file defines the class UpgradeServices, which provides a service method to generate SQL scripts for altering table timestamp columns to support microseconds in MySQL. It includes permission checks, entity metadata processing, and file output logic.

classes.name: UpgradeServices
classes.description: A utility class providing a service to generate SQL scripts for updating timestamp columns in MySQL tables to support microseconds.

methods.name: generateMySqlFileWithAlterTableForTimestamps
methods.description: Generates an SQL file with ALTER TABLE statements to modify datetime and time columns to include microsecond support, based on entity metadata and permissions.
